name: Spellhardt family
desc:
The Spellhardt family are a noble family of Lightborn, originating from the city of [Constellia](location:constellia), currently residing in [the Floating Keep](location:the_floating_keep).

Before the fall of [Constellia](location:constellia), the Keep was very well-manned. Shortly after the aforementioned event, [the Keep](location:the_floating_keep) was left solely in the hands of the family, to be managed by themselves.

The Spellhardt Family has a tradition, called Hallowtide, which they still keep going purely for their own entertainment, as it gets lively in the Keep.

They are known to covet pumpkins and to be the creators of toffee.
